     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GrassmannianRepresentability
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveMorphismBasic
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.OnePointRelPicCollapse
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Projective.GrassmannianProjective
    10	import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Constructions.BinaryProducts
    11	
    12	/-!
    13	# H-quasi-projectivity transport for Grassmannian representers
    14	
    15	This file isolates the transport needed by the D4' divisor route. An
    16	H-quasi-projectivity certificate for the absolute Grassmannian over `Spec Z`
    17	base-changes to the explicit relative free Grassmannian. Over a field, a
    18	locally free module is globally free, so uniqueness of representing objects
    19	then transports the certificate to the chosen `Scheme.Grassmannian`
    20	representer.
    21	
    22	The absolute certificate is constructed by the Plucker embedding in
    23	`Projective/GrassmannianProjective.lean`. The conditional transport theorem is
    24	retained to isolate the base-change argument, and the unconditional theorem at
    25	the end consumes the absolute certificate.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	open CategoryTheory Limits
    29	
    30	noncomputable section
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	namespace Scheme
    34	namespace Grassmannian
    35	
    36	private noncomputable def pullbackTopFreeIso {T : Scheme.{0}}
    37	    (N : T.Modules) (I : Type)
    38	    (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (⊤ : T.Opens).ι).obj N ≅
    39	      SheafOfModules.free (R := (⊤ : T.Opens).toScheme.ringCatSheaf) I) :
    40	    N ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := T.ringCatSheaf) I :=
    41	  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackTopIsoSelf N).symm ≪≫
    42	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback T.topIso.inv).mapIso e ≪≫
    43	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackFreeIso T.topIso.inv I
    44	
    45	private theorem globallyFreeSpecField {K : Type} [Field K]
    46	    {V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules} {r : ℕ}
    47	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank V r) :
    48	    Nonempty (V ≅ SheafOfModules.free
    49	      (R := (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf) (Fin r)) := by
    50	  let S : Scheme.{0} := Spec (CommRingCat.of K)
    51	  obtain ⟨ι, U, hU, htriv⟩ := hV
    52	  let x : S := Classical.arbitrary S
    53	  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, U i := by rw [hU]; trivial
    54	  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hx
    55	  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hx
    56	  let W : S.Opens := U i
    57	  have hxW : x ∈ W := hxi
    58	  have hW : W = ⊤ := Scheme.Opens.eq_top_of_subsingleton W hxW
    59	  have htrivW : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj V ≅
    60	      SheafOfModules.free (R := W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    61	        (ULift.{0} (Fin r))) := htriv i
    62	  clear_value W
    63	  subst W
    64	  obtain ⟨e⟩ := htrivW
    65	  refine ⟨pullbackTopFreeIso V _ e ≪≫ ?_⟩
    66	  exact (SheafOfModules.freeFunctor (R := S.ringCatSheaf)).mapIso
    67	    (Equiv.toIso Equiv.ulift)
    68	
    69	private theorem productHQuasiProjectiveOfAbsolute (d r : ℕ)
    70	    (habs : (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.toSpecZ d r).IsHQuasiProjective)
    71	    (S : Scheme.{0}) :
    72	    (((Over.star S).obj
    73	      (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme d r)).hom).IsHQuasiProjective := by
    74	  let G : Scheme.{0} := AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme d r
    75	  let hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk
    76	      (prod.snd : S ⨯ G ⟶ G) (prod.fst : S ⨯ G ⟶ S)
    77	      (specZIsTerminal.hom_ext
    78	        ((prod.snd : S ⨯ G ⟶ G) ≫
    79	          AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.toSpecZ d r)
    80	        ((prod.fst : S ⨯ G ⟶ S) ≫ specZIsTerminal.from S))) :=
    81	    isPullbackOfIsTerminalIsProduct
    82	      (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.toSpecZ d r)
    83	      (specZIsTerminal.from S)
    84	      (prod.snd : S ⨯ G ⟶ G) (prod.fst : S ⨯ G ⟶ S)
    85	      specZIsTerminal (prodIsProd S G).binaryFanSwap
    86	  let e : (S ⨯ G) ≅ pullback
    87	      (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.toSpecZ d r)
    88	      (specZIsTerminal.from S) :=
    89	    hc.conePointUniqueUpToIso (limit.isLimit _)
    90	  have he : e.hom ≫ pullback.snd
    91	      (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.toSpecZ d r)
    92	      (specZIsTerminal.from S) = (prod.fst : S ⨯ G ⟶ S) :=
    93	    hc.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp
    94	      (limit.isLimit _) WalkingCospan.right
    95	  have hprod : (prod.fst : S ⨯ G ⟶ S).IsHQuasiProjective := by
    96	    rw [← he]
    97	    exact (habs.baseChange (specZIsTerminal.from S)).comp_isImmersion e.hom
    98	  change (prod.lift prod.fst (𝟙 (S ⨯ G)) ≫
    99	    prod.fst).IsHQuasiProjective
   100	  rw [prod.lift_fst]
   101	  exact hprod
   102	
   103	/-- Over a field, H-quasi-projectivity of the absolute Grassmannian transports
   104	to the chosen scheme representing locally free rank-`d` quotients of `V`.
   105	
   106	This theorem isolates the exact reduction used by D4'. Its only projective
   107	input is the certificate for `Grassmannian.toSpecZ`; no explicit
   108	`RepresentableBy` witness is added to the consumer signature. -/
   109	theorem representingScheme_isHQuasiProjective_of_field_of_absolute
   110	    {K : Type} [Field K]
   111	    {V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules} {r d : ℕ}
   112	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank V r)
   113	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r)
   114	    (habs : (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.toSpecZ d r).IsHQuasiProjective) :
   115	    (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom.IsHQuasiProjective := by
   116	  obtain ⟨eV⟩ := globallyFreeSpecField hV
   117	  let S : Scheme.{0} := Spec (CommRingCat.of K)
   118	  let Y : Over S := (Over.star S).obj
   119	    (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.scheme d r)
   120	  let repY : (Scheme.Grassmannian V d).RepresentableBy Y :=
   121	    (prodRepresentableBy S d r hd hdr).ofIso
   122	      ((Scheme.Grassmannian.congrIso eV d ≪≫ freeCompare d r).symm)
   123	  let E : representingScheme hV hd hdr ≅ Y :=
   124	    (representation hV hd hdr).uniqueUpToIso repY
   125	  rw [← E.hom.w]
   126	  exact (productHQuasiProjectiveOfAbsolute d r habs S).comp_isImmersion
   127	    E.hom.left
   128	
   129	/-- Over a field, the chosen scheme representing locally free rank-`d`
   130	quotients of `V` is H-quasi-projective. -/
   131	theorem representingScheme_isHQuasiProjective_of_field
   132	    {K : Type} [Field K]
   133	    {V : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules} {r d : ℕ}
   134	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank V r)
   135	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
   136	    (representingScheme hV hd hdr).hom.IsHQuasiProjective := by
   137	  exact representingScheme_isHQuasiProjective_of_field_of_absolute hV hd hdr
   138	    (AlgebraicGeometry.Grassmannian.isHQuasiProjective_toSpecZ d r)
   139	
   140	end Grassmannian
   141	end Scheme
   142	end AlgebraicGeometry

     5	-/
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.FiniteMapProjectiveGluing
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ProjectiveCoordinateRelativeChart
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The projective immersion attached to a finite two-chart map
    11	
    12	The two distinguished homogeneous coordinates cut out target charts whose
    13	inverse images are exactly the two pulled-back Laurent charts.  On each chart,
    14	the global relative coordinate morphism is the closed immersion supplied by
    15	the algebra-generating coordinate family.  Target-locality then makes the
    16	global morphism an immersion.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	noncomputable section
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization
    26	  TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Adelic
    29	namespace LaurentChartData.FiniteMapGenerators
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    32	variable {Y C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    33	variable {D : LaurentChartData Y} {pi : C ⟶ Y}
    34	variable (G : D.FiniteMapGenerators pi)
    35	
    36	/-- The coordinate normalized to one on the first source chart. -/
    37	abbrev firstIndex : G.ProjectiveIndex :=
    38	  Sum.inl ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ G.d⟩
    39	
    40	/-- The coordinate normalized to one on the second source chart. -/
    41	abbrev secondIndex : G.ProjectiveIndex :=
    42	  Sum.inl ⟨G.d, Nat.lt_succ_self G.d⟩
    43	
    44	/-- The target chart selected by the first distinguished coordinate. -/
    45	def targetOpen0 : (ℙ(G.ProjectiveIndex; Spec (.of k))).Opens :=
    46	  ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt G.ProjectiveIndex (Spec (.of k)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    47	    Proj.basicOpen
    48	      (homogeneousSubmodule G.ProjectiveIndex (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X G.firstIndex)
    49	
    50	/-- The target chart selected by the second distinguished coordinate. -/
    51	def targetOpen1 : (ℙ(G.ProjectiveIndex; Spec (.of k))).Opens :=
    52	  ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt G.ProjectiveIndex (Spec (.of k)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    53	    Proj.basicOpen
    54	      (homogeneousSubmodule G.ProjectiveIndex (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X G.secondIndex)
    55	
    56	/-- The first target open is the corresponding relative affine chart. -/
    57	def targetOpen0IsoAffineChartAt :
    58	    G.targetOpen0.toScheme ≅
    59	      ProjectiveSpace.affineChartAt G.ProjectiveIndex G.firstIndex (Spec (.of k)) := by
    60	  apply IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq G.targetOpen0.ι
    61	    (ProjectiveSpace.affineChartAt.incl

   128	/-- The section ring of an open and the global sections of its open subscheme
   129	are canonically isomorphic. -/
   130	def openSectionsEquiv (U : C.left.Opens) :
   131	    Γ(C.left, U) ≃+* Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) :=
   132	  (asIso (U.ι.appLE U ⊤ U.ι_preimage_self.ge)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

   134	/-- The section-ring equivalence respects the structural `k`-algebra map. -/
   135	theorem openSectionsEquiv_algebraMap (U : C.left.Opens) (c : k) :
   136	    openSectionsEquiv U (algebraMap k Γ(C.left, U) c) =
   137	      (U.ι ≫ C.hom).appTop.hom
   138	        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom c) := by
   139	  change (U.ι.appLE U ⊤ U.ι_preimage_self.ge).hom
   140	      (algebraMap k Γ(C.left, U) c) = _
   141	  have hL : algebraMap k Γ(C.left, U) c =
   142	      (C.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
   143	        (C.hom.appTop.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom c)) := rfl
   144	  rw [hL]
   145	  change (C.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op ≫
   146	      U.ι.appLE U ⊤ U.ι_preimage_self.ge).hom
   147	        (C.hom.appTop.hom ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom c)) = _
   148	  rw [Scheme.Hom.map_appLE, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop]
   149	  simp only [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, homOfLE_refl,
   150	    op_id, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
   151	  have hid := congrArg
   152	    (fun q : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ↦ q.hom
   153	      (U.ι.appTop.hom (C.hom.appTop.hom
   154	        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom c))))
   155	    (U.toScheme.presheaf.map_id (Opposite.op (⊤ : U.toScheme.Opens)))
   156	  simpa using hid

   170	          (k := k) (B := Γ(C.left, U)) =

   175	      ProjectiveSpace.Coordinates.specToBase
   176	        (k := k) (B := Γ(C.left, U))).appTop.hom

   178	    (U.ι ≫ C.hom).appTop.hom

   183	        (k := k) (B := Γ(C.left, U))).appTop.hom
   184	          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom c)) = _

   187	        (k := k) (B := Γ(C.left, U))).appTop.hom
   188	          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom c) =
   189	        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(C.left, U)).inv.hom

    14	/-!
    15	# Finite-morphism embeddings
    16	
    17	This file supplies two pieces of the standard proof that finite morphisms are
    18	projective. Over an affine target, a finite morphism is a closed subscheme of
    19	finite-dimensional affine space. At the other end of the compactification
    20	argument, a proper immersion into projective space is already closed.
    21	
    22	The remaining geometric step is to place the affine embedding in a projective
    23	chart and globalize it over the target. These results isolate both sides of
    24	that step without adding a projectivity hypothesis.

    40	projective. Properness makes the immersion closed. -/
    41	theorem of_isProper_of_immersion (hpi : IsProper pi) {n : Type u} [Finite n]
    42	    (i : X ⟶ ℙ(n; S)) (hi : IsImmersion i)
    43	    (hcomp : i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) = pi) : pi.IsProjective := by
    44	  letI : IsImmersion i := hi
    45	  haveI : IsProper (i ≫ (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S)) := hcomp ▸ hpi
    46	  haveI : IsProper i := IsProper.of_comp i (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S)
    47	  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i :=
    48	    (IsClosedImmersion.iff_isProper_and_mono (f := i)).mpr
    49	      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    50	  exact ⟨n, inferInstance, i, inferInstance, hcomp⟩

   164	/-- A finite morphism over an affine target is a closed subscheme of a

   166	theorem exists_closedImmersion_affineSpace {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)

   170	  letI : IsAffine X := isAffine_of_isAffineHom f
   171	  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤) := RingHom.toAlgebra f.appTop.hom

   173	  obtain ⟨n, hn, q, hq⟩ :=
   174	    Algebra.FiniteType.iff_quotient_mvPolynomial'.mp
   175	      (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType Γ(Y, ⊤) Γ(X, ⊤))
   176	  letI : Fintype n := hn
   177	  let i : X ⟶ 𝔸(n; Y) :=
   178	    AffineSpace.homOfVector f fun j => q (MvPolynomial.X j)
   179	  refine ⟨n, inferInstance, i, ?_, AffineSpace.homOfVector_over _ _⟩
   180	  apply IsClosedImmersion.of_surjective_of_isAffine
   181	  intro x
   182	  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hq x
   183	  refine ⟨(AffineSpace.isoOfIsAffine n Y).hom.appTop
   184	    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPolynomial n Γ(Y, ⊤)))).inv p), ?_⟩
   185	  rw [AffineSpace.isoOfIsAffine_hom_appTop]
   186	  simp only [CommRingCat.comp_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
   187	  change (i.appTop.hom.comp
   188	    (eval₂Hom (𝔸(n; Y) ↘ Y).appTop.hom (AffineSpace.coord Y))) p = q.toRingHom p
   189	  apply DFunLike.congr_fun ?_ p
   190	  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
   191	  · intro r
   192	    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, eval₂Hom_C]
   193	    rw [show q.toRingHom (C r) = f.appTop.hom r by
   194	      change q (C r) = f.appTop.hom r
   195	      exact q.commutes r]
   196	    have h := congrArg Scheme.Hom.appTop (AffineSpace.homOfVector_over f
   197	      (fun j => q (MvPolynomial.X j)))
   198	    rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop] at h
   199	    exact congrArg (fun e : Γ(Y, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X, ⊤) => e.hom r) h
   200	  · intro j
   201	    simp [i]
   202	
   203	/-- A finite morphism to an affine target is projective. The affine embedding
   204	lands in the standard open chart of projective space, and properness turns the
   205	resulting immersion into a closed immersion. -/
   206	theorem isProjective_of_isAffine {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
   207	    [IsFinite f] [IsAffine Y] : f.IsProjective := by
   208	  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, hif⟩ := exists_closedImmersion_affineSpace f
   209	  letI : Finite n := hn
   210	  letI : IsClosedImmersion i := hi
   211	  let j : X ⟶ ℙ(Option n; Y) :=
   212	    i ≫ ProjectiveSpace.standardOpenImmersion n Y
   213	  have hj : IsImmersion j := by
   214	    dsimp [j]
   215	    infer_instance
   216	  apply Scheme.Hom.IsProjective.of_isProper_of_immersion
   217	    (pi := f) (by infer_instance) j hj
   218	  dsimp [j]
   219	  rw [Category.assoc, ProjectiveSpace.standardOpenImmersion_over, hif]
   220	
   221	end IsFinite
   222	
   223	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# Core divisor-to-Grassmannian classifying objects
    11	
    12	This file contains the small representation-facing core of D2: the twisted
    13	divisor sheaf, its evaluation map, and the resulting locally free quotient and
    14	Grassmannian class.  The longer analytic proofs live in
    15	`DivGrassmannianEmbedding`; keeping this core separate lets the D3 universal
    16	candidate import it without recompiling that large module.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	namespace Scheme
    28	
    29	namespace DivFamily
    30	
    31	variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}
    32	
    33	/-- The twist of the divisor structure sheaf by a module on the original
    34	family.  For the D2 embedding, `L` is the chosen sufficiently positive
    35	projective twist. -/
    36	noncomputable def twist (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) :
    37	    (pullback π T.hom).Modules :=
    38	  Modules.tensorObj ((Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L) x.F
    39	
    40	/-- Tensor the divisor quotient `O -> O_D` with the pulled-back twist. -/
    41	noncomputable def twistQuotientMap (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) :
    42	    (Modules.pullback (pullback.fst π T.hom)).obj L ⟶ x.twist L :=
    43	  (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor _).inv ≫
    44	    Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 _)
    45	      ((Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π T.hom)).inv ≫ x.q)
    46	
    47	/-- The canonical D2 evaluation morphism.  It first base-changes `π_* L`
    48	from `S` to `T`, then pushes forward the twisted divisor quotient along
    49	`X_T -> T`. -/
    50	noncomputable def grassmannianEval (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) :
    51	    (Modules.pullback T.hom).obj ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) ⟶
    52	      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L) :=
    53	  pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom (pullback.snd π T.hom)
    54	      (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L ≫
    55	    (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map (x.twistQuotientMap L)
    56	
    57	/-- The evaluation map is epi as soon as its two displayed factors are epi. -/
    58	theorem grassmannianEval_epi (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T)
    59	    (hbase : Epi (pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom
    60	      (pullback.snd π T.hom) (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L))
    61	    (hquot : Epi ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
    62	      (x.twistQuotientMap L))) :
    63	    Epi (x.grassmannianEval L) := by
    64	  letI := hbase
    65	  letI := hquot
    66	  dsimp [grassmannianEval]
    67	  infer_instance
    68	
    69	/-- Package the D2 evaluation as a rank-`d` locally free quotient. -/
    70	noncomputable def grassmannianQuotient (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T)
    71	    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ} (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    72	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    73	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    74	    LocallyFreeQuotient ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d T := by
    75	  letI := hEpi
    76	  exact {
    77	    F := (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)
    78	    q := x.grassmannianEval L
    79	    epi := inferInstance
    80	    locFree := hLocFree }
    81	
    82	/-- The quotient-class value of the D2 comparison in the relative
    83	Grassmannian functor. -/
    84	noncomputable def grassmannianClass (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T)
    85	    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ} (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    86	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    87	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    88	    (Grassmannian ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d).obj (Opposite.op T) :=
    89	  Quotient.mk _ (grassmannianQuotient L x hEpi hLocFree)
    90	
    91	/-- The componentwise form of `grassmannianClass`: once the base-change and
    92	divisor-quotient factors are epi, only the target's rank condition remains. -/
    93	noncomputable def grassmannianClassOfComponents (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T)
    94	    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    95	    (hbase : Epi (pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom
    96	      (pullback.snd π T.hom) (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L))
    97	    (hquot : Epi ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
    98	      (x.twistQuotientMap L)))
    99	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   100	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
   101	    (Grassmannian ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) d).obj (Opposite.op T) :=
   102	  grassmannianClass L x (grassmannianEval_epi L x hbase hquot) hLocFree
   103	
   104	end DivFamily
   105	
   106	end Scheme
   107	
   108	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# The universal Grassmannian candidate for a divisor
    11	
    12	This file connects the D2 divisor-to-Grassmannian class to the D3
    13	curve-side candidate quotient.  It is kept downstream of both constructions
    14	so changes to this bridge do not force the large D2 development to recompile.
    15	-/
    16	
    17	set_option autoImplicit false
    18	
    19	universe u
    20	
    21	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	namespace Scheme
    26	
    27	namespace DivFamily
    28	
    29	variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}
    30	
    31	/-- The reconstructed Grassmannian evaluation kills the relations of an
    32	actual divisor family.  The proof is the adjunction transpose of
    33	`kernel.ι (grassmannianEval L x) ≫ grassmannianEval L x = 0`; it uses no
    34	additional hypothesis beyond the data already needed to form that quotient. -/
    35	theorem grassmannianKernelEvaluation_comp_twistQuotientMap
    36	    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    37	    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    38	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    39	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    40	    LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    41	        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
    42	      x.twistQuotientMap L = 0 := by
    43	  let q := x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree
    44	  change LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L q ≫
    45	    x.twistQuotientMap L = 0
    46	  apply ((Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
    47	    (pullback.snd π T.hom)).homEquiv _ _).injective
    48	  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right]
    49	  simp only [LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    50	  change (kernel.ι q.q ≫
    51	      pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom (pullback.snd π T.hom)
    52	        (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L) ≫
    53	      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map
    54	        (x.twistQuotientMap L) = _
    55	  rw [Category.assoc]
    56	  change kernel.ι q.q ≫ q.q = _
    57	  rw [kernel.condition, Adjunction.homAddEquiv_zero]
    58	  rfl
    59	
    60	/-- The canonical comparison from the Grassmannian candidate cokernel to the
    61	twisted sheaf of an actual divisor family. -/
    62	noncomputable def grassmannianCandidateToTwist
    63	    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    64	    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    65	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    66	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    67	    cokernel (LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    68	      (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree)) ⟶ x.twist L :=
    69	  cokernel.desc _ (x.twistQuotientMap L)
    70	    (grassmannianKernelEvaluation_comp_twistQuotientMap
    71	      L x hEpi hLocFree)
    72	
    73	/-- The candidate quotient followed by its comparison is the original
    74	twisted divisor quotient. -/
    75	theorem grassmannianCandidateQuotient_comp_candidateToTwist
    76	    (L : X.Modules) (x : DivFamily π T) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
    77	    (hEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
    78	    (hLocFree : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    79	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
    80	    LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
    81	        (x.grassmannianQuotient L hEpi hLocFree) ≫
    82	      grassmannianCandidateToTwist L x hEpi hLocFree =
    83	        x.twistQuotientMap L :=
    84	  cokernel.π_desc _ _ _
    85	
    86	end DivFamily
    87	
    88	namespace Grassmannian
    89	
    90	variable {S X : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S} [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    91	
    92	/-- The curve-side evaluation map attached to the universal quotient on the
    93	chosen scheme representing `Grassmannian (π_* L) d`. -/
    94	noncomputable def universalKernelEvaluation (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
    95	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
    96	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
    97	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
    98	  LocallyFreeQuotient.kernelEvaluation L
    99	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   100	
   101	/-- The universal candidate quotient on
   102	`X ×_S representingScheme (Grassmannian (π_*L) d)`. -/
   103	noncomputable def universalCandidateQuotient (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
   104	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   105	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
   106	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
   107	  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient L
   108	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   109	
   110	/-- The kernel of the universal candidate quotient.  This is the actual
   111	curve-side module whose invertible locus D3 must carve out; the kernel of the
   112	Grassmannian quotient itself lives on the base and has the wrong rank.  Its
   113	ordinary `lineBundleLocus` lies in the total space `X_G`; D3 must still descend
   114	the whole-fibre condition to a locus in the Grassmannian base `G`. -/
   115	noncomputable def universalCandidateIdeal (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
   116	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   117	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
   118	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :=
   119	  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateIdeal L
   120	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   121	
   122	/-- The universal candidate quotient is epimorphic by its cokernel
   123	construction. -/
   124	theorem universalCandidateQuotient_epi (L : X.Modules) {r d : ℕ}
   125	    (hV : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   126	      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L) r)
   127	    (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdr : d ≤ r) :
   128	    Epi (universalCandidateQuotient L hV hd hdr) :=
   129	  LocallyFreeQuotient.candidateQuotient_epi L
   130	    (universalQuotient hV hd hdr)
   131	
   132	end Grassmannian
   133	
   134	end Scheme
   135	
   136	end AlgebraicGeometry

    18	/-!
    19	# The divisor-to-Grassmannian comparison
    20	
    21	This file begins campaign milestone D2': a divisor family is twisted by a fixed
    22	module on the curve, and the pullback--pushforward base-change map followed by
    23	the divisor quotient gives the canonical evaluation morphism used by the
    24	Grassmannian construction.
    25	
    26	The core definitions are unconditional and live in
    27	`DivGrassmannianClass`.  In particular,
    28	`DivFamily.grassmannianEval` exists before the Riemann--Roch argument proves it
    29	epimorphic.  Keeping the map separate from its eventual `Epi` proof prevents
    30	uniform generation from becoming an assumption in the definition of the
    31	comparison.
    32	
    33	The second section records two affine algebra bridges used to turn finite flat
    34	pushforwards into the rank-indexed local-freeness predicate expected by
    35	`Scheme.LocallyFreeQuotient`.  They do not introduce a representability gate:
    36	their inputs are ordinary finite-presentation, finiteness, and projectivity
    37	properties with producers elsewhere in the Picard development.
    38	-/
    39	
    40	set_option autoImplicit false
    41	
    42	universe u
    43	
    44	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory
    45	
    46	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    47	
    48	namespace Scheme
    49	
    50	namespace DivFamily
    51	
    52	variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}
    53	
    54	private lemma map_tensorHom_comp2 {C D : Type*} [Category C] [MonoidalCategory C]
    55	    [Category D] (F : C ⥤ D) {a₀ a₁ a₂ b₀ b₁ b₂ : C}
    56	    (a : a₀ ⟶ a₁) (b : a₁ ⟶ a₂) (d : b₀ ⟶ b₁) (e : b₁ ⟶ b₂) :
    57	    F.map (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom a d) ≫ F.map (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom b e) =
    58	      F.map (MonoidalCategory.tensorHom (a ≫ b) (d ≫ e)) := by
    59	  rw [← F.map_comp, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
    60	
    61	/-- Equivalent divisor families have isomorphic twists, compatibly with the
    62	twisted quotient maps.  This is the representative-level descent input for
    63	the D2' Grassmannian comparison. -/
    64	lemma twistQuotientMap_rel (L : X.Modules) {x y : DivFamily π T} (h : x.Rel y) :
    65	    ∃ f : x.twist L ≅ y.twist L,
    66	      x.twistQuotientMap L ≫ f.hom = y.twistQuotientMap L := by
    67	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h
    68	  refine ⟨Modules.tensorObjIsoOfIso (Iso.refl _) f, ?_⟩
    69	  change ((Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor _).inv ≫
    70	      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 _)
    71	        ((Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π T.hom)).inv ≫ x.q)) ≫
    72	      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 _) f.hom =
    73	    (Modules.tensorObj_right_unitor _).inv ≫
    74	      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 _)
    75	        ((Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π T.hom)).inv ≫ y.q)
    76	  rw [Category.assoc]
    77	  rw [show Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 _) _ ≫
    78	        Modules.tensorObj_functoriality (𝟙 _) f.hom =
    79	      Modules.tensorObj_functoriality ((𝟙 _) ≫ (𝟙 _))
    80	        (((Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π T.hom)).inv ≫ x.q) ≫ f.hom) by
    81	    simp only [Modules.tensorObj_functoriality]
    82	    exact map_tensorHom_comp2
    83	      (C := _root_.PresheafOfModules
    84	        ((pullback π T.hom).presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    85	      _ _ _ _ _]
    86	  simp only [Category.id_comp]
    87	  rw [Category.assoc, hf]
    88	
    89	/-- Equivalent divisor families have isomorphic evaluation targets, and the
    90	isomorphism commutes with the D2' evaluation maps. -/
    91	lemma grassmannianEval_rel (L : X.Modules) {x y : DivFamily π T} (h : x.Rel y) :
    92	    ∃ f : (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L) ≅
    93	        (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (y.twist L),
    94	      x.grassmannianEval L ≫ f.hom = y.grassmannianEval L := by
    95	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := twistQuotientMap_rel L h
    96	  refine ⟨(Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).mapIso f, ?_⟩
    97	  change (pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom (pullback.snd π T.hom)
    98	      (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L ≫
    99	        (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map (x.twistQuotientMap L)) ≫
   100	      (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map f.hom =
   101	    pushforwardBaseChangeMap π T.hom (pullback.snd π T.hom)
   102	      (pullback.fst π T.hom) pullback.condition L ≫
   103	        (Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).map (y.twistQuotientMap L)
   104	  rw [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, hf]
   105	
   106	/-- Epimorphy of the D2' evaluation map is invariant under
   107	`DivFamily.Rel`. -/
   108	lemma grassmannianEval_epi_of_rel (L : X.Modules) {x y : DivFamily π T}
   109	    (h : x.Rel y) (hx : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L)) :
   110	    Epi (y.grassmannianEval L) := by
   111	  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := grassmannianEval_rel L h
   112	  letI := hx
   113	  rw [← hf]
   114	  infer_instance
   115	
   116	/-- The rank-local-freeness obligation on the D2' evaluation target is
   117	invariant under `DivFamily.Rel`. -/
   118	lemma grassmannianTarget_isLocallyFreeOfRank_of_rel
   119	    (L : X.Modules) {x y : DivFamily π T} (hxy : x.Rel y) {d : ℕ}
   120	    (hx : SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   121	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (x.twist L)) d) :
   122	    SheafOfModules.IsLocallyFreeOfRank
   123	      ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π T.hom)).obj (y.twist L)) d := by
   124	  obtain ⟨f, _⟩ := grassmannianEval_rel L hxy
   125	  obtain ⟨ι, U, hU, hloc⟩ := hx
   126	  exact ⟨ι, U, hU, fun i =>
   127	    ⟨(Modules.pullback (U i).ι).mapIso f.symm ≪≫ (hloc i).some⟩⟩
   128	
   129	/-- The conditional D2' quotient datum respects the divisor-family
   130	equivalence relation.  The epi and rank witnesses on the second representative
   131	are transported from the first, rather than assumed again. -/
   132	lemma grassmannianQuotient_rel
   133	    (L : X.Modules) {x y : DivFamily π T} [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {d : ℕ}
   134	    (hxy : x.Rel y) (hxEpi : Epi (x.grassmannianEval L))
